properties.name: Sample property · realistic English, Filipino and mixed reviews

reviews.text: Malinis yung room and mabait ang landlord. Fast ang wifi, sulit sa price.
Good place for students. Wifi is fast, quiet at night, and the landlord is very approachable.
Okay lang yung place, medyo mahal ang rent pero malinis naman. Mabilis ang wifi.
Quiet neighborhood, near jeepney and 7-eleven. Landlord is responsive. Nice place overall!
Sobrang tahimik dito, perfect for studying. Malinis ang CR at may tubig palagi.
The room is small but clean. Wifi is slow sometimes. Price is reasonable for the area.
Maingay sa gabi kasi malapit sa kalsada. Hindi ko nagustuhan ang noise. Pero mabait yung landlord.
Great location, near the school and market. Malinis at maayos ang buong unit. Would recommend!
Hindi malinis yung CR when we moved in, pero nilinis naman agad ng landlord. Wifi works fine.
Affordable price and quiet area. The place is safe and the owner is friendly.
Nice and clean room, strong wifi, kind landlord. Good value for the price.
Tahimik at safe ang lugar, malapit sa tindahan. Okay naman ang wifi, medyo mahal lang ang kuryente.
